summary: Jeanne Bliss recounts a formative experience at Land's End that shaped her commitment to customer-centric product design. She describes a culture of trust that empowered staff to make the right decisions for customers, and she emphasizes building products by listening to real customers. A concrete example describes inviting real women to test swimsuits in a pool, gathering direct feedback on fit (such as cup placement and back fit), and using those words to drive business decisions. The talk culminates in a pledge to pursue this customer-focused approach throughout her career.
title: Real-World Customer Feedback Drives Swimwear Design: The Land's End Experience
topics: translating customer words into business decisions
